scope: historical matched-query extension; original queries unchanged across all controls
action_cost: record displacement, report full historical set and <=3m subset separately; subset is conditional analysis, not local replanning
architecture: same MLP 297*2->64->1, bound2, 30 epochs, patience6, lr.001, TRAIN normalization, VAL reference IoU selection
reference_ranker: same 297-dimensional sensory features including cross-bank evidence, but only reference candidates may be selected
reference_expansion: same trained reference ranker and selection; deterministic geometric extension after selection
union: reference plus fused candidates under same query/evidence/supervision
reference_audio_control: Same 38145-parameter ranker, first 245 reference acoustic/geometry features, cross-bank 52 features zeroed, no second LiDAR evidence. Added before campaign freeze to separate ranking training from added geometry.
reference_evidence_control: Same reference candidates but all 297 cross-bank sensory descriptors; isolates adding fused candidates at matched evidence.
